title: North Vietnam Tour Package
highlights: Experience breathtaking views of limestone formations and emerald waters on an overnight cruise through the UNESCO World Heritage site, Ha Long Bay.
Witness the beauty of Vietnam with our North Vietnam package tours, showcasing the culturally rich city of Hanoi, majestic mountains of Ham Rong, and stunning landscapes of Ha Long.
Visit the Temple of Literature in Hanoi, featuring traditional Vietnamese architecture across five beautifully landscaped courtyards, adorned with elegant pavilions and ornate gates.
Enjoy a cable car ride to Fansipan Peak (3147 m) and relish the spectacular view of terraced rice fields and the majestic Hoang Lien Son mountain range.
overview:
About the destinations:
Explore the breathtaking destinations with our captivating North Vietnam package tours. Hanoi, a vibrant city, boasts ancient architecture and lively streets that pulse with energy. Sa Pa is renowned for its stunning terraced rice fields and majestic mountains, offering breathtaking views, particularly from Ham Rong Mountain. Fansipan Peak, accessible by cable car, provides an unparalleled panorama of the surrounding landscape. Finally, Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site, enchants visitors with its emerald waters and striking limestone islands, making it an essential highlight of any North Vietnam itinerary.

know_before_you_go: Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Images are for representation purpose only.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival in Hanoi, you will be transferred to your hotel. Check in and take this day to relax or explore the city at your pace. You can stroll through the charming 87 May Street, visit St. Joseph’s Cathedral, or enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of Hanoi Botanical Garden. Also, take a look at the Statue of Lenin, a special gift that Russia gave to Vietnam. After this, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hanoi City Tour
days.desc: Today, dive into the rich history and culture of Hanoi with a city tour. Visit the Ngoc Son Temple Hanoi, Hoan Kiem Lake, and the Temple of Literature, each reflecting Vietnam’s heritage. Also, explore Bat Trang Ceramic Village, where you can shop for local handicrafts. Indulge in a delicious lunch during your tour that will keep you energised. Later, admire the vibrant Huc Bridge, before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Sa Pa | Trek to Ham Rong Mountain
days.desc: Check out and travel to Sa Pa. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and prepare for a trek to Ham Rong Mountain. As you hike, enjoy breathtaking views of the valleys and explore beautiful gardens. Experience the local culture as you meet friendly locals during the trek. Upon reaching the summit, see clusters of clouds beneath your feet and admire the panoramic view of Sapa town, Muong Hoa Valley, Cat Cat Village, and the terraced rice fields of Ta Van. Later, get transferred to the hotel.

days.title: Cable Car Ride to Fansipan Peak
days.desc: Today, embark on a thrilling adventure with a cable car ride to Fansipan Peak, the highest mountain in Indochina. Marvel at the panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys as you ascend. From the summit, take in the awe-inspiring landscape comprising forests, hill villages, Sa Pa Valley, and the town. Spend some time at the peak taking in the fresh mountain air. After this, you will be dropped off at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ha Long Bay | Overnight Cruise
days.desc: On this day, get ready to depart for Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site famous for its emerald waters and limestone islands. Upon reaching, board your cruise and enjoy stunning ocean views while sailing through the breathtaking landscape. You can spend the afternoon relaxing on deck and watch a beautiful sunset. Spend the night on the cruise, creating unforgettable memories.

days.title: Deboard the Cruise | Transfer to Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Deboard the cruise and get transferred to Hanoi. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and enjoy a leisure day. You can visit Phu Tay Ho, a serene lakeside area or the Ho Chi Minh Complex and Presidential Palace to learn about Vietnam's history. Explore the artistic Hanoi Ceramic Mosaic Mural, the world’s largest ceramic mosaic. Also, visit the elegant Hanoi Opera House, where you can soak in the local culture and perhaps catch a performance. Afterwards, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel, you will be transferred to the airport for your departure. This marks the end of your trip to North Vietnam. We hope you depart with cherished memories and look forward to welcoming you again in the future.
